description: Implement an LRU cache with get/put operations
prompt: Write a Python class `LRUCache` with: __init__(self, capacity: int), get(self, key: int) -> int (returns -1 if not found), put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None (evicts least recently used when at capacity). Do NOT use functools. Use OrderedDict or a custom doubly-linked list. Include test_lru_cache() testing: basic get/put, capacity eviction, access-order update on get.
expected_behavior: LRU cache correctly evicts least recently used items, get() updates recency

validation_criteria.l4: test_lru_cache() passes: put/get, eviction, recency update
validation_criteria.l5: O(1) get and put operations, correct eviction order
